descriptions.account: How teammates and coaches find you.
descriptions.experience: Coaches use this to plan and to pair sparring safely.
descriptions.goals: Pick any. Home and your weekly plan follow your goals.
descriptions.weight: Used to suggest sparring partners and plan camps.
descriptions.gym: Connecting a gym will let you book classes and check in with your phone.
descriptions.membership: Joining, choosing a membership and booking a trial will happen here.
descriptions.coach: Working with a coach is always free for fighters.
descriptions.privacy: Safe defaults. You'll be able to change them per post or in Settings.
descriptions.friends: Friends are mutual. Following is one-way.
descriptions.notifications: Training first. Social stays grouped and quiet.

fight_preparation.title: Fight Preparation
fight_preparation.body: A fight date to peak for

weight.private: Weight is private. Only you see it. Never on cards, feeds, leaderboards or sponsor analytics.

gym.body: Gyms aren't on SimpleFit yet. Once they are, you'll find yours here, join by invite or scan its QR code. Nothing is linked to your profile now.

membership.body: There's no gym to join yet, so no membership is chosen and no join request is sent.

coach.body: Coaches arrive later. You'll join yours by invite or find one nearby; nothing is requested now.

privacy.body: Privacy settings arrive with Settings. Until then your fighter profile isn't published anywhere.
privacy.neverPublic: Never public · never shown to sponsors

friends.body: Friends arrive with Community. No one is added or invited now.

notifications.body: Notification settings arrive later. Nothing is turned on and your phone isn't asked for anything now.

board.body: Every gym, partner and session connects here over time. It stays private until you choose to share it.

timer.label: Train
timer.title: Rounds, not reps
timer.body: The boxing timer runs your rounds and rest — and logs every round to your journal. No typing between rounds.

art.log: Every round lands in your journal
art.description: An example round timer: round 3 of 6, two minutes fourteen left, rest next.

coach.label: Your corner
coach.title: Your coach and gym, in your pocket
coach.body: Bookings, programs and messages in one place. Training with your coach is always free.

art.private: Weight, pain notes and coach notes stay private by default.

board.title: This is your Live Board
board.body: Gyms, people and sessions, connected over time. Only you see it until you share a card.

training.title: Train and log
training.body: The round timer, your coach’s plan and every session you log. Create a shared session to train together.

community.title: Your people
community.body: Friends’ trainings, your gym’s community and challenges — only what people choose to share.

profile.title: Profile and settings
profile.body: Record, progress, fight camps and gym passes. Privacy, data export and workspaces live here too.
